summary: hashicorp.terraform.configuration_version manages configuration versions. Required: workspace_id or workspace plus organization, and configuration_files_path (a directory auto-packed into .tar.gz, or a .tar.gz archive) for state: present. Example sets auto_queue_runs false, tf_validate_certs, poll_interval and poll_timeout.
questions: How do I upload Terraform configuration with hashicorp.terraform?
What file types does configuration_files_path accept?

answer_card.title: hashicorp.terraform.configuration_version
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Create configuration version
  hashicorp.terraform.configuration_version:
    workspace_id: ws-1234
    configuration_files_path: "/usr/home/tf"
    auto_queue_runs: false
    tf_validate_certs: true
    poll_interval: 3
    poll_timeout: 15
    state: present
```
Required: `workspace_id` (or `workspace` + `organization`) and `configuration_files_path`, a directory (packed to .tar.gz automatically) or a .tar.gz archive.
